parsed.notes:
“Who you are” supplies required qualifications; there is no optional qualifications heading. Responsibilities and “What you will learn” do not independently establish candidate skills.
Interest is accepted instead of experience in ML frameworks, so machine-learning, PyTorch, and TensorFlow are nice_to_have. The two concrete framework examples form one alternative group; the broad skill remains outside it.
Seniority is null because the posting explicitly welcomes contributors of all seniorities and candidates at various experience levels, despite the 5+ years qualification and lead duties.
Physical design methodologies and named EDA techniques are treated literally as technical practices, not merely domain knowledge. Generic “data skills” is retained as unmapped rather than inferred to mean a particular data technique.
